measures.id: Hancock County ADAMH Board Tax Levy
measures.title: Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal) – Hancock County Board of Alcohol, Drug Addiction and Mental Health Services
measures.summary: Asks Hancock County voters whether to renew an existing property tax levy for the Hancock County Board of Alcohol, Drug Addiction and Mental Health Services. The Board of Elections' notice lists it for all Hancock County precincts.
measures.yesMeans: The ADAMH Board levy is renewed.
